sections.markdown:
## B — Audience and scope: speed, turning and parking

Audience: first-time Colorado applicants preparing for the written driving knowledge test, including teens seeking an instruction permit and adults new to the state or never licensed.
Level: plain English at a middle-school reading level; many applicants are English learners, so terms are defined on first use and legal phrasing is restated simply.
Prerequisites: none assumed beyond basic familiarity with riding in a car; no prior driving experience or traffic-law vocabulary is expected.
Scope of this section: speed, turning and parking, as stated on the selected handbook pages only; commercial, motorcycle-endorsement and vehicle-registration procedures are out of scope.
Depth: every rule, exception and quantity on the selected pages is captured in the knowledge part so the downstream builders need no re-research.

corpus_stability.reason: Handbook edition DR 2337 is dated 12/05/24 (file Jan2025); its rules are statutory and are not revised more than once a year.
